## What's new in 0.1.53

- **New 3D Aira logo** for the app icon and the welcome screen.
- **Founder card in About:** talk to the founder on LinkedIn, Telegram (@druboG) or email.
- **English everywhere:** Chinese UI languages and Chinese-app guides are removed. Model providers have English names, with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, Groq, Mistral and other global providers listed first.
- **Offline voice packs** download inside the app from Aira's own GitHub release, so the app stays small.
- **Chat-app remote control is removed** (Telegram, WeChat and Feishu). Aira already runs on your phone, so you talk to it directly.
- **Note:** if your phone has an older Aira that was not installed from GitHub Releases, uninstall it first, then install this version.

## Install

**Option 1 — direct:** download **Aira.apk** below and open it on your Android phone (Android 10 or later).

**Option 2 — with automatic updates (recommended):**
1. Install **Obtainium** from https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/releases (download the `app-arm64-v8a-release.apk` file).
2. On your phone, open this link: https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://add/https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/Aira
   Or, in Obtainium tap **Add App**, paste `https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/Aira` and tap **Add**.
3. Tap **Install**. From now on Obtainium tells you when a new Aira version is out.
